jobs.title: Cashier, SM Bacolod
jobs.description: We are looking for a Cashier to serve as an important control point in the completion of each customer purchase. This position will be reporting to work at SM Bacolod. You will report directly to the Store Supervisor. Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Verify merchandise description, quantity, price, discounts, and transaction totals. Confirm that scanned merchandise corresponds to the actual items purchased. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. Address routine checkout inquiries and refer disputed matters to the Store Head. Thank customers sincerely and conclude transactions with the brand's customer service standards. Check merchandise condition and confirm that the correct items and quantities are released. Remove security tags or other applicable security devices following approved procedures. jobs.title: Research Assistant for Climate Action
jobs.description: The Research Specialist for Climate Action (RS-CA) will work with the Climate and Disaster Resilience Program of AIS through priority projects expressed in the nascent Climate Action Plan (CAP). These include a green space management tool for the University’s vegetation, and a disaster literacy index under development. Additionally, the RS-CA will also perform duties related to the climate action and disaster resilience in the University. The RS-CA reports to the Program Head for Climate and Disaster Resilience. The Research Specialist for Climate Action: facilitates focus group discussions and deploy survey questionnaire to an extensive sample size from various units of the University; conducts data gathering (e.g., surveys, FGDs) and analysis, using the necessary statistical tools, codes, and softwares; conducts, builds on, and synthesizes research on green spaces in the University, by reviewing policies and documents on their proper use, carbon sequestration potential, and biodiversity support potential develops appropriate tools on green space management in the University towards climate resilience and biodiversity support, accounting for its different typologies; writes reports and creates the accompanying presentations related to the research projects of the Climate and Disaster Resilience program, which include the study on disaster literacy index for the University and the green space management; provides supports to major office events, such as conferences; performs all other duties as may be reasonably required of the position, in accordance with the instructions of the Immediate Supervisor, and their duly authorized representative.

Support users and colleagues in adopting AI tooling for everyday workplace tasks.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Project Engineer
jobs.description: Cloud Security Project Engineer (Client-Facing Professional Services) About the Role We are looking for a Cloud Security Project Engineer to join our team and support cloud security implementations for enterprise customers in the Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) region. This is a hands-on technical and client-facing role. You will work with customers, partners, and internal teams to implement, troubleshoot, and support cloud security solutions. You don't need to be a pure Project Manager. We are looking for someone with a strong background in networking, cloud security, firewalls, proxies, or security technologies who is also comfortable communicating with customers and managing multiple projects. Experience with Netskope is a strong advantage, but candidates with experience in similar technologies such as Zscaler, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, or other SASE/SSE platforms are welcome to apply. What You'll Do Manage multiple customer implementation projects from kickoff to completion. Work with customers and partners to understand their technical requirements and deployment needs. Lead or support technical meetings, workshops, and implementation sessions. Configure, implement, and troubleshoot cloud security solutions. Work with technologies such as SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, ZTNA, and DLP. Support traffic steering, proxy, PAC file, VPN, IPsec/GRE tunnel, and SSL/TLS configurations. Troubleshoot connectivity, latency, traffic steering, PAC file, SSL inspection, and security policy issues. Coordinate with Sales, Support, Engineering, Professional Services, and Partners to keep projects moving. Track project activities, timelines, milestones, and technical deliverables. Handle customer questions and technical issues and escalate when needed. Support customers during implementation and hyper-care after deployment.
